name: WEMIX Dollar
oneLiner: WEMIX Dollar is the WEMIX ecosystem's centralized dollar token, backed by USDC and fiat reserve assets on the non-EVM-indexed WEMIX chain.
collateral: USDC and fiat reserve assets held for WEMIX Dollar on WEMIX3.0; issuer materials describe full collateralization by secure on-chain and off-chain assets.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption system using WEMIX$ treasury collateral, DIOS stabilization, and USDC/fiat reserve management to keep WEMIX$ near one U.S. dollar.

applicabilityBasis.summary: WEMIX Dollar (WEMIX$) is a USD-pegged, fiat-backed stablecoin issued by WEMIX PTE. LTD. (Singapore) under a permissioned mint-and-redemption model collateralized by USDC and fiat reserves. It circulated as the native settlement currency of the WEMIX3.0 gaming blockchain and was accessible to US-person users via international exchanges, matching the GENIUS Act definition of a payment stablecoin. The issuer announced a wind-down and transition to USDC.e in 2025; circulating supply has declined significantly but remains non-zero as of mid-2026 (CoinGecko reports approximately 14.5M WEMIX$ in circulation). Applicability is assessed on the basis of the token's design and issuance during its active life.

genius.notes: WEMIX PTE. LTD. (UEN 201903432D, formerly WEMADE TREE PTE. LTD.) is a Singapore-incorporated subsidiary of South Korean game developer WEMADE. The issuer announced in 2025 that WEMIX$ would be wound down and replaced by USDC.e (Circle bridged USDC via Chainlink CCIP). As of June 2026, CoinGecko (the coin's configured detailProvider) reports approximately 14.5M WEMIX$ still in circulation with minimal trading activity (~$33/day volume on WEMIX.Fi), indicating the wind-down is substantially advanced but not yet complete. No GENIUS Act PPSI application, foreign-issuer registration, or authorization announcement has been located. The foreign exception status is not-applicable because the GENIUS Act's foreign-issuer registration framework (Treasury comparability rule) remains in proposed-rules phase as of June 2026 and no determinations have been made. The issuer has made no public announcement of intent to engage with the GENIUS framework.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Checked WEMIX official news (no GENIUS engagement found), Singapore corporate registry sources confirming entity identity (UEN 201903432D, formerly WEMADE TREE PTE. LTD.), OCC GENIUS NPRM and Federal Register (no mention of WEMIX or its issuer entity), and web searches for WEMIX + GENIUS Act or US payment stablecoin compliance (no results found). The token is being wound down and the issuer has made no public statements about US stablecoin regulation compliance.

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: WEMIX Dollar primarily circulates on WEMIX chain, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

mintAuthority.summary: WEMIX$ is issued through the WEMIX3.0 MINT contract under Authorized Mint Access (AMA), granted only to the WEMIX foundation at launch, against USDC deposited into the Treasury; an algorithmic DIOS stabilizer manages the peg but the mint permission is concentrated in the issuer.

controls.label: WEMIX Authorized Mint Access (AMA) holder
controls.evidence: WEMIX docs state issuance is controlled by the MINT contract and that the AMA (Authorized Mint Access) right was granted only to the WEMIX foundation at launch, minting WEMIX$ 1:1 against USDC deposited to the Treasury; DIOS (TIP/TOP) is an automated stabilizer rather than an open mint route, so supply creation is permissioned to the issuer.

review.evidence: WEMIX$ is the WEMIX3.0 ecosystem stablecoin minted via the MINT contract under Authorized Mint Access held by the WEMIX foundation, with USDC Treasury collateral and an automated DIOS price stabilizer; there is no permissionless or user-collateralized mint path.
review.sourceFreeRationale: WEMIX chain is non-EVM-indexed and no contract is stored in Pharos; mint mechanism resolved from issuer docs (AMA + MINT + DIOS) rather than a live on-chain admin read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain AMA/MINT contract owner on WEMIX chain and whether AMA has been extended beyond the foundation.
